title: Intra-Sect Faction Conflict
description: Within your sect, two factions (e.g. conservative elders vs progressive disciples) clash over adopting a new teaching. You are asked to take sides.

title: Rival's Turncoat Revelation
description: A rival disciple is discovered to be passing sect secrets to another sect. The accusation may be true, or may be manipulation.

title: Regional Threat Rises
description: A demon clan or corrupt official in the region begins abusing their power. Neighboring sects consider forming a coalition.

title: Sect Qualifier Tournament
description: Your sect is hosting or competing in a qualifier to select its representatives for a grand tournament between sects.

title: Political Marriage Offer
description: A famed sect suggests a marriage alliance between you (or your sect) and another powerful sect to cement peace—or mutual leverage.

title: Ambush on Rival's Route
description: You hear whispers that rival sect disciples plan to ambush your route to the mountain sect meeting. Danger or opportunity to counter-strike.

title: Secret Society Infiltration
description: A clandestine group working against many sects invites you to join or spy. Risk of betrayal and moral compromise.

title: Grand Auction of Rare Items
description: An auction is held among multiple sects to acquire extremely rare relics or scrolls. Price, face, and reputation all at stake.

title: Tournament Between Sects
description: A grand tournament invites disciples from many sects. Prestige, possible promotions, and rivalries sharpen.

title: Sect Reform Bill Proposal
description: Some elders propose reform: more meritocracy vs nepotism. It causes loud debate among senior vs noble born disciples.

title: Relic Dispute Between Sects
description: Two sects both claim ownership of a relic. Your sect looks to you for diplomatic or martial support.

choices.text: Defend your sect's claim in battle

title: Heart Trial Request
description: An ancient temple is rumored to offer a heart trial: facing one's deepest fears to unlock part of one's dao. Only serious disciples apply.

title: Mentor Crisis
description: Your mentor becomes ill (or is compromised) during a breakthrough. Sect is split: heal him/cure or replace with political prestige choice.

title: Corrupted Site Discovery
description: An ancient cultivation site once pure is now corrupted by dark qi. The sect wants to cleanse it but fears backlash or cost.

title: Sect Diplomatic Envoy
description: Your sect sends you as envoy to another sect to negotiate border, trade, or mutual protection pacts.

title: Inner Circle Offer
description: An opportunity to join your sect's inner circle is offered, but with strings attached: more duty, political risk, and possible betrayal.

title: Duel of Ideologies
description: You and a rival debate the philosophical approach of cultivation (e.g. strict rule vs flexible path); duel afterward to settle honor.

choices.text: Win debate then fight or compromise

title: Spellbinders Gathering
description: Gathering of magic/wizardry sects and alchemy sects. New symbol techniques revealed; some are flashy and potentially destructive.

title: Divine Tribulation Omen
description: An omen signals a coming trial from the heavens. Energy in the air, celestial signs. Will sect prepare or ignore it?

title: Training Camp with Competitors
description: Multiple sects send disciples to a joint training camp—rivalry, alliances, pranks, and skill exchange abound.

title: Rebuild Old Sect Faction
description: You learn of a fallen branch of your sect or an allied sect. Rebuilding it could give influence but costs resources and trust.

title: Sect Border Dispute
description: Border lands claimed by your sect and a rival sect overlap. Tensions simmer over territory and spirit resources.

title: Forbidden Library Leak
description: Some knowledge from your sect's forbidden library leaks out. Embarrassment, risk, potential for power shift.

title: Strange Ally from Other Sect
description: A disciple from another sect offers alliance/protection or strange trade. Motives unclear (help, betrayal, or satire).

title: Seed of Corruption Among Elder
description: One of the senior elders is revealed to be hoarding forbidden qi or using demonic techniques for their own rise. Moral test for you.

title: Duel for Sect Leadership
description: After the current leader's health fails, disciples compete (politically and in single combat) to succeed them. You may be invited or have to pick side.

title: Retribution for Old Grudge
description: An old grudge against your sect (or your family) resurfaces: previous insult or humiliation. Do you respond or let go?

title: Blade-Stealing Sabotage
description: Someone steals ceremonial blades/weapons from your sect or rivals. Investigation, suspicion, and blame fly.

title: Alliance Breakdown
description: A cooperating sect betrays terms of an alliance (trade, shared missions). You must decide how to react.

title: Heavenly Court Notice
description: The Heavenly Court issues a decree affecting sects: possibly restricting forbidden arts, calling cultivators for service, or taxing relics.

title: Corrupted River Spread
description: A river flowing through sect lands becomes corrupted; crops dying, qi unstable. Could be a natural disaster or curse.

title: Rival Assassination Attempt
description: Someone attempts to kill your rival (or you are implicated). Spillover into sect politics and honor issues.

title: Final Breakthrough
description: You attempt your final breakthrough in Act 3, achieving new power.
